big: Nifty Financial Services is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

h: What is the Nifty Financial Services?
lines: What does the Nifty Financial Services track?

The Nifty Financial Services Index is designed to reflect the behaviour and performance of the Indian financial market which includes banks, financial institutions, housing finance, insurance companies and other financial services companies. It holds 20 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.
